result:
If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would make it so that every individual has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water, as well as reliable sanitation facilities. This is a fundamental human right, essential for health, dignity, and overall well-being.

Clean water and sanitation are crucial for preventing the spread of diseases, reducing child mortality rates, and improving educational and economic opportunities. Despite being a basic necessity, millions of people around the world still lack access to these essentials, disproportionately affecting vulnerable communities.

By ensuring universal access to clean water and sanitation, we could significantly improve global health outcomes, promote sustainable development, and create a more equitable world.
